_comment: Branch protection config applied to main of every MiraNote-AI repo. Hardened from the dasgpt baseline by setting `restrictions` to an empty allowlist, which means NO direct push to main is permitted -- not even by owners. All changes must land via PR. Owners with admin rights can still merge their own PRs via `gh pr merge --admin`, but cannot bypass the PR step itself. `required_status_checks` is null; the `checks / checks` context name is known (verified via miranote-web#1 smoke test) and can be added back if desired by editing this file and rerunning `bin/apply-branch-protection.sh`.
